  • OCR'd the NTSC DVD English subtitles, which were very slightly better than the USA PGS subs. Unfortunately neither were SDH.

  • The French PGS subtitles are coloured and positional:



  • Named chapters sourced and synced from the USA Blu-ray. Chapter times synced to scene changes/I-frames.
